blocks.text: Superfluids aisa anokha behaviour dikhate hain jo aam fluids aur gases mein nahi hota. Maslan kitab ke mutabiq helium-3 bartan ki deewaron par charh kar bahar nikal sakta hai; ise film flow kehte hain. Yeh bohat hi bareek suraakhon (pores) aur daraaron mein se bhi guzar jata hai jahan se aam liquid nahi guzar sakta. Hilane par superfluids mein bhanwar (vortices) bante hain jo khatam nahi hote, jab ke aam fluids kuch der baad ruk jate hain. Superfluid ka bartan ghumayein to andar ka liquid ruka rehta hai, coffee ke cup ki tarah saath nahi ghoomta. Superfluid mein normal aur superfluid dono hisse mile hote hain; temperature jitna kam, superfluid hissa utna zyada. Kuch superfluids garmi bohat achhi guzarte hain (high thermal conductivity). Yaad rahe ke superfluidity aur superconductivity alag cheezein hain; helium-3 aur helium-4 dono superfluid hain magar bijli nahi guzarte.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke superfluid bartan ki deewaron mein se guzar sakta hai. Asal mein superfluid thos deewar mein se nahi guzarta; viscosity na hone ki wajah se yeh bohat bareek suraakhon aur daraaron (superleak) se guzar jata hai jahan se aam liquid nahi guzarta. Film flow (deewar par charhna) sab se zyada superfluid helium-4 mein dekha jata hai.
